downloads.title: Download Zentico Workspace
downloads.body: Use your workspace as an app on your computer or phone. The first time, enter your workspace address ({host}).
downloads.signinLinkGeneric: Get the desktop and mobile apps

note.windows: If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info" → "Run anyway".
note.android: Open the downloaded file and allow "install unknown apps" if Android asks.
